messages.description: Short secondary label in the account menu and workspace picker, helping users distinguish workspaces with the same name. details is date when a creation date is available, otherwise none. date is a localized creation calendar date including the year. showId is yes when the date is missing or matches another workspace, otherwise no. id is a distinguishing workspace ID suffix, not a name.
